metadata.title: Dubai RTA Dynamic Wireless Charging Corridor Assumptions Registry
metadata.description: Standardized, published, and measured parameters for dynamic wireless power transfer and vehicle energy modeling.

airDensity_kg_m3.name: Ambient Air Density
airDensity_kg_m3.sourceName: U.S. Standard Atmosphere (COESA 1976) & Dubai Climate Meteorological Data
airDensity_kg_m3.note: Standard air density at sea level (1.204 kg/m³ at 20°C, 1.225 kg/m³ at 15°C); Dubai summer ambient (38°C–43°C) reduces density to 1.116–1.134 kg/m³.
airDensity_kg_m3.rangeBasis: Calculated across Dubai seasonal temperatures: 43°C summer extreme (min: 1.116 kg/m³), 28°C annual mean (typical: 1.184 kg/m³), and 15°C ISA sea level (max: 1.225 kg/m³).

costPerKm_USD.name: Electrified Road Infrastructure Cost per Lane-Km
costPerKm_USD.sourceName: Swedish Transport Administration (Trafikverket) & French Ministry/Cerema ERS Studies
costPerKm_USD.note: Estimated capital expenditure per electrified lane-km based on European ERS pilot benchmarks (€1.0M–€2.7M/km).
costPerKm_USD.rangeBasis: Trafikverket large-scale mature rollout projection (€1.0M/km or ~$1.1M) up to high-complexity highway retrofit pilots (€2.7M/km or ~$3.0M).

coilPower_kW.name: Dynamic Inductive Coil Power
coilPower_kW.sourceName: ElectReon & Vinci Autoroutes Dynamic Induction Pilots (Electric Road)
coilPower_kW.note: Nominal power delivered per vehicle receiver; transit buses typically operate with a 75 kW receiver assembly.
coilPower_kW.rangeBasis: 20 kW for light-duty EV coils up to 200 kW for multi-receiver heavy commercial vehicle assemblies.

couplingEfficiency.name: Magnetic Induction Transmission Coupling Efficiency
couplingEfficiency.sourceName: BMWK German ERS Road Trial & Arena del Futuro / Vinci A10 Pilot Evaluations
couplingEfficiency.note: Grid-to-battery induction efficiency: 64.3% measured in German BMWK trials; 75%–85% reported in French highway trials; 90% peak on bench.
couplingEfficiency.rangeBasis: Empirical range between 64.3% measured in German highway pilot and 90% theoretical peak bench coupling.

mass_kg.name: 12m Transit Bus Total Mass
mass_kg.sourceName: BYD Auto K-Series 12m Transit Bus Datasheet
mass_kg.note: 12-meter electric transit bus: 13,500 kg curb weight, 18,000 kg gross vehicle weight limit.
mass_kg.rangeBasis: Empty curb weight (13,500 kg) to fully loaded passenger gross weight (18,000 kg); typical reflects ~25 seated passengers.

crr.name: Rolling Resistance Coefficient (Class C3)
crr.sourceName: ISO 28580 / UNECE R117 Rolling Resistance Standards (Class C3 Commercial Tires)
crr.note: Rolling resistance coefficient for Class C3 transit bus and heavy commercial vehicle radial tires.
crr.rangeBasis: UNECE R117 Class C3 grading bands: low-resistance radial (0.0045) to standard transit radial (0.0080).

cda_m2.name: Aerodynamic Drag Area (Cd * A)
cda_m2.sourceName: Engineering ToolBox Vehicle Drag & BYD K-Series Bus Body Dimensions
cda_m2.note: Effective drag area Cd * A for 12m city transit bus (width 2.55m, height 3.20m, frontal area ~7.5 m², Cd ~0.55–0.70).
cda_m2.rangeBasis: Frontal area ~7.5 m² multiplied by Cd range of 0.55 (streamlined coach) to 0.70 (boxy city transit bus).

motorEfficiency.name: Electric Drive Powertrain Efficiency
motorEfficiency.sourceName: U.S. Department of Energy / EPA Vehicle Efficiency & Electric Traction Motor Ratings
motorEfficiency.note: Combined inverter and traction motor efficiency across typical urban transit duty cycles.
motorEfficiency.rangeBasis: 85% during low-speed high-torque operation to 95% peak efficiency at nominal operating speed.

regenEfficiency.name: Regenerative Braking Round-Trip Efficiency
regenEfficiency.sourceName: Regenerative Braking Systems Thermodynamic and Electrical Recapture Evaluations
regenEfficiency.note: Round-trip electrical and electrochemical recapture efficiency from wheel kinetic energy back to traction battery.
regenEfficiency.rangeBasis: 50% typical real-world urban cycle recapture to 85% optimal electrical generator recovery.

regenCeiling_mps2.name: Maximum Regenerative Deceleration Ceiling
regenCeiling_mps2.sourceName: Electric Vehicle Regenerative Deceleration Comfort Limits and Brake Blending Controls
regenCeiling_mps2.note: Software and stability ceiling for pure regenerative deceleration before friction mechanical braking engages.
regenCeiling_mps2.rangeBasis: 1.0 m/s² (~0.10g) passenger comfort threshold, 2.0 m/s² (~0.20g) typical limit, up to 3.0 m/s² (~0.31g) maximum blend ceiling.

auxiliaryLoad_W.name: Auxiliary Electrical Load (HVAC & Subsystems)
auxiliaryLoad_W.sourceName: Electric Bus Auxiliary Loads & HVAC Thermal Management in High Ambient Climates
auxiliaryLoad_W.note: Auxiliary electrical power draw including passenger cabin AC, battery thermal management, and power steering.
auxiliaryLoad_W.rangeBasis: 3,000 W idle electronics up to 22,000 W during peak Dubai summer cabin pull-down at 40°C–45°C ambient.

solarPanelArea_m2.name: Usable Rooftop Solar Panel Area
solarPanelArea_m2.sourceName: BYD K-Series Transit Bus Rooftop Dimensions and Solar Demo Evaluations
solarPanelArea_m2.note: Net usable rooftop surface area for photovoltaic cells on a 12m transit bus.
solarPanelArea_m2.rangeBasis: Total roof footprint (30.6 m²) less HVAC units, escape hatches, and maintenance walkways yields 10 to 22 m².

solarPanelEfficiency.name: Solar Cell Conversion Efficiency
solarPanelEfficiency.sourceName: NREL & Standard Commercial Silicon Photovoltaic Module Efficiency Ratings
solarPanelEfficiency.note: Efficiency of commercial monocrystalline silicon solar cells at STC (Standard Test Conditions, 25°C, 1000 W/m²).
solarPanelEfficiency.rangeBasis: 18% standard commercial silicon module to 24.5% high-efficiency production silicon cell.

mass_kg.name: Passenger EV / Taxi Total Mass
mass_kg.note: Tesla Model 3 electric taxi: 1,610 kg base curb weight, 1,847 kg Long Range with driver and luggage, 2,060 kg GVWR.
mass_kg.rangeBasis: Base curb weight empty (1,610 kg) to fully loaded Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (2,060 kg).

crr.name: Rolling Resistance Coefficient (Class C1)
crr.sourceName: ISO 28580 / UNECE R117 Rolling Resistance Standards (Class C1 Passenger Tires)
crr.note: Rolling resistance coefficient for Class C1 passenger car EV-grade low rolling resistance radial tires.
crr.rangeBasis: 0.0065 (top-tier EV tire) to 0.0120 (standard all-season passenger tire).

cda_m2.name: Aerodynamic Drag Area (Cd * A)
cda_m2.sourceName: Tesla Model 3 Aerodynamic Drag Coefficient and Frontal Area Specifications
cda_m2.note: Aerodynamic drag area: Cd = 0.23, Frontal Area A = 2.22 m² yields CdA = 0.5106 m².
cda_m2.rangeBasis: Cd 0.23 with base aerodynamic wheels (0.490 m²) to Cd 0.25 with accessories and wide tires (0.580 m²).

motorEfficiency.name: Electric Drive Powertrain Efficiency
motorEfficiency.sourceName: U.S. Department of Energy / EPA Vehicle Efficiency (fueleconomy.gov)
motorEfficiency.note: Permanent magnet synchronous motor and SiC inverter combined drivetrain efficiency.
motorEfficiency.rangeBasis: 86% under mixed stop-and-go load to 96% peak efficiency on highway cruise.

regenEfficiency.name: Regenerative Braking Round-Trip Efficiency
regenEfficiency.sourceName: Electric Car Energy Efficiency & Regenerative Brake Evaluations
regenEfficiency.note: Passenger car regenerative braking recovery efficiency back to the battery pack.
regenEfficiency.rangeBasis: 55% in aggressive braking events to 88% in gradual highway regeneration.

regenCeiling_mps2.name: Maximum Regenerative Deceleration Ceiling
regenCeiling_mps2.sourceName: Regenerative Braking Deceleration Limits & One-Pedal Driving Benchmarks
regenCeiling_mps2.note: One-pedal driving and blended regen limit: typically up to 2.0 m/s² (0.2g) before hydraulic brakes engage.
regenCeiling_mps2.rangeBasis: Comfortable throttle lift-off (1.0 m/s²) to full blended regen threshold (3.0 m/s²).

auxiliaryLoad_W.name: Auxiliary Electrical Load (HVAC & Subsystems)
auxiliaryLoad_W.sourceName: Electric Car Cabin Heating and Cooling Power Demands (Electric Car)
auxiliaryLoad_W.note: Passenger vehicle auxiliary electrical load including air conditioning, cabin blower, computers, and lights.
auxiliaryLoad_W.rangeBasis: 400 W baseline electronics up to 4,500 W maximum AC compressor draw under high desert heat.

solarPanelArea_m2.name: Usable Rooftop Solar Panel Area
solarPanelArea_m2.sourceName: Passenger EV Glass Roof Solar Integration Dimensions
solarPanelArea_m2.note: Available roof area for embedded solar photovoltaic cells on a compact executive sedan.
solarPanelArea_m2.rangeBasis: 1.2 m² for partial roof glass to 2.4 m² for entire panoramic roof canopy.

solarPanelEfficiency.name: Solar Cell Conversion Efficiency
solarPanelEfficiency.sourceName: Commercial Solar Cell Efficiency Records and Production Modules
solarPanelEfficiency.note: Efficiency of production monocrystalline photovoltaic cells.
solarPanelEfficiency.rangeBasis: 18% standard commercial panels to 24.5% high-efficiency IBC cells.

mass_kg.name: Electric Scooter / Moped Total Mass (with Rider)
mass_kg.sourceName: NIU NQi GTS Electric Scooter Technical Specifications
mass_kg.note: 115 kg NIU NQi GTS dual-battery electric scooter curb weight plus 75 kg rider (total 190 kg).
mass_kg.rangeBasis: 170 kg (light rider 55 kg) to 220 kg (heavy rider plus delivery cargo payload).

crr.name: Rolling Resistance Coefficient (Two-Wheeler / Moped)
crr.sourceName: ISO 28580 / Motorcycle Tire Rolling Resistance Standards
crr.note: Rolling resistance coefficient for 14-inch pneumatic moped/scooter road tires.
crr.rangeBasis: 0.012 for high-pressure low-rolling-resistance tires to 0.020 for lower-pressure urban commuting tires.

cda_m2.name: Aerodynamic Drag Area (Cd * A)
cda_m2.sourceName: Motorcycle & Scooter Aerodynamic Drag Area Benchmarks
cda_m2.note: Aerodynamic drag area for upright commuting rider on a step-through electric scooter.
cda_m2.rangeBasis: 0.45 m² for compact rider tuck to 0.70 m² for upright rider with delivery top box.

motorEfficiency.name: Electric Drive Powertrain Efficiency
motorEfficiency.note: Efficiency of brushless DC (BLDC) permanent-magnet hub or mid-drive motor including inverter.
motorEfficiency.rangeBasis: 80% low-cost hub motor to 90% premium liquid/air-cooled synchronous drive.

regenEfficiency.name: Regenerative Braking Round-Trip Efficiency
regenEfficiency.note: Net mechanical-to-battery energy recovery efficiency for light electric two-wheelers.
regenEfficiency.rangeBasis: 45% simple BLDC regenerative braking to 75% advanced field-oriented controller recovery.

regenCeiling_mps2.name: Maximum Regenerative Deceleration Ceiling
regenCeiling_mps2.sourceName: Electric Two-Wheeler Braking Dynamics and Stability Guidelines
regenCeiling_mps2.note: Maximum deceleration ceiling for electric two-wheeler regenerative braking to maintain rear-wheel tire traction.
regenCeiling_mps2.rangeBasis: 1.0 m/s² conservative wet pavement limit to 2.0 m/s² dry pavement maximum.

auxiliaryLoad_W.name: Auxiliary Electrical Load (Lighting & Electronics)
auxiliaryLoad_W.note: Continuous electrical power drawn by LED headlight, taillight, instrument cluster, and BMS logic.
auxiliaryLoad_W.rangeBasis: 20 W daytime running lights to 80 W high-beam and connected telemetry load.

solarPanelArea_m2.name: Usable Solar Panel Area (Delivery Top Box)
solarPanelArea_m2.note: Usable surface area on the lid of a rear delivery box for flexible solar photovoltaic cells.
solarPanelArea_m2.rangeBasis: 0.10 m² small parcel box lid to 0.30 m² full-size thermal delivery carrier lid.

solarPanelEfficiency.name: Solar Cell Conversion Efficiency
solarPanelEfficiency.rangeBasis: 18% standard commercial panels to 24.5% high-efficiency IBC cells.

signalStopProbability.name: Traffic Signal Stop Probability
signalStopProbability.sourceName: Highway Capacity Manual (HCM 6th Edition) & FHWA Traffic Signal Timing Manual
signalStopProbability.note: Probability that an arriving vehicle encounters an uncoordinated red signal phase; equal to red clearance ratio (1 - g/C).
signalStopProbability.rangeBasis: 0.30 for coordinated arterial progression green band up to 0.70 for uncoordinated or minor street phases.

signalAverageWait_s.name: Average Signal Stopped Wait Delay
signalAverageWait_s.sourceName: Highway Capacity Manual (HCM) Uniform Delay Formulation for Signalized Intersections
signalAverageWait_s.note: Average stopped dwell delay experienced by vehicles arriving during the red phase for a 60–120s cycle length.
signalAverageWait_s.rangeBasis: 15s for short cycle minor phases up to 60s for long 120s arterial red phases.

junctionSlowdownSpeed_kmh.name: Motorway Junction / Interchange Advisory Speed
junctionSlowdownSpeed_kmh.sourceName: AASHTO Green Book / UAE Road Design Guidelines for Motorway Interchange Ramps and Junctions
junctionSlowdownSpeed_kmh.note: Advisory safe speed limit for vehicles negotiating motorway interchange slip roads and arterial weaving segments.
junctionSlowdownSpeed_kmh.rangeBasis: 40 km/h for tight loop slip ramps to 80 km/h for high-speed directional interchange ramps.

roadway_piezoelectric.name: Roadway Piezoelectric Harvester Power Output
roadway_piezoelectric.sourceName: None verified (commercial roadway piezoelectric viability not demonstrated in peer-reviewed literature)
roadway_piezoelectric.note: No verified or measured field deployment has demonstrated net-positive electrical harvest from roadway embedded piezoelectric elements.

vehicle_mounted_wind_turbine.name: Vehicle-Mounted Wind Turbine Net Power
vehicle_mounted_wind_turbine.sourceName: Excluded by First and Second Laws of Thermodynamics
vehicle_mounted_wind_turbine.note: Mounting a wind turbine on a moving vehicle increases aerodynamic drag power proportionally higher than turbine output, causing net battery loss.
